errors.text_span: Над стълбите са посочени процентите на електрическите автомобили от общия брой продадени автомобили за всяка година, например 21,6% за 2023
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the 21.6% value to 2023. The image shows 21.6% for 2022 and 22.3% for 2023.
The y-axis is labeled as 'Брой автомобили' without specifying units in thousands, though the values are clearly in absolute numbers.
The description does not explicitly mention the yellow bars representing the percentage of total sales, only the percentages above the bars.
The description omits the exact y-axis range (0 to 3,500,000) and only describes it as reaching up to 3,500,000 without specifying the lower bound or interval structure.
The description does not mention the legend position at the bottom center of the figure.
